criterion: A name that exists counts as recognizable when a Rich Python call, translated only by the mechanical Rust adaptations (varargs -> iterator, slice or builder push; keyword arguments -> builder methods or typed fields; omitted defaults -> explicit default value; str -> &str or impl Into<String>; exceptions -> Result; constructor -> Type::new or a named constructor), keeps the same operation, the same argument roles and the same positional order. It does not count when the positional order differs, an argument role is missing without an alternative on the same item, or the same name denotes a different role or type.
sensitivity: The 70% line is 28 of 40. The count is 37 of 40 (92.5%). It stays at or above 70% even if every contested item is rejected (Text.stylize, Progress.update, Console.force_terminal: 34 of 40 = 85.0%).
reviewer: evaluation fork of v0.7, same criterion text as version 1, written before the v0.7 DX run and applied to every one of the 40 names; unchanged items keep their version 1 verdict and note. Version 1 is not edited.

items.name: Console
items.note: Rich Console(...); hud Console::stdout() / stderr() / builder(): constructor named by stream, same role.

items.name: Console.print
items.note: Rich print(*objects, ...); hud print(&renderable): one renderable, groups via Group.

items.name: Console.width
items.note: Rich width (property, int); hud width(&self) -> usize: same role. The builder keeps width(u16) as Rich's constructor keyword.

items.name: Console.is_terminal
items.note: Rich is_terminal (property, bool); hud is_terminal(&self) -> bool: terminal or forced to act as one.

items.name: Console.color_system
items.note: Rich color_system (property, str or None); hud color_system(&self) -> ColorSystem: str -> typed enum, None -> ColorSystem::None.

items.name: Console.no_color
items.note: Rich no_color (attribute set by the constructor keyword, bool); hud no_color(&self) -> bool: color is off, attributes stay on.

items.name: Console.force_terminal
items.note: Rich has no public attribute of this name: force_terminal is a constructor keyword. hud has ConsoleBuilder::force_terminal(bool) (keyword -> builder method, same role) and the accessor Console::force_terminal(&self) -> bool. CONTESTED.

items.name: Color.parse
items.note: Rich Color.parse(color: str) -> Color, raises ColorParseError; hud Color::parse(&str) -> Result<Color, StyleError>: exceptions -> Result, same role and order.

items.name: Text.append
items.note: Rich append(text, style=None); hud append(text, style): explicit default.

items.name: Text.stylize
items.note: Rich stylize(style, start=0, end=None); hud stylize(style, range: impl RangeBounds<usize>): style first as in Rich, start and end carried by one range whose open ends are Rich's omitted defaults. CONTESTED: start and end become one role; offsets are bytes (D-044).

items.name: Text.truncate
items.note: Rich truncate(max_width, *, overflow=None, pad=False); hud truncate(&mut self, max_width, overflow, pad): keywords -> trailing positional parameters with explicit defaults, same roles.

items.name: Text.wrap
items.note: Rich wrap(console, width, *, justify, overflow, tab_size, no_wrap) -> Lines; hud wrap(&self, width) -> Vec<Text>: the console role is missing without an alternative on the same item (styles are typed; the keywords are Text builder methods, D-044). Counted as NOT recognizable under the criterion.

items.name: Table.add_column
items.note: Rich add_column(header, ...); hud add_column(impl Into<Column>), Column::new(header).

items.name: Progress.add_task
items.note: Rich add_task(description, start, total, ...); hud add_task(description, total): total positional and required.

items.name: Progress.advance
items.note: Rich advance(task_id, advance=1); hud advance(task, amount): amount required.

items.name: Progress.update
items.note: Rich update(task_id, *, total, completed, advance, description, visible, refresh, **fields); hud update(&task) -> TaskUpdate with total, completed, advance, description, visible, refresh: keyword-only -> builder methods. CONTESTED: **fields is not supported (D-045).

items.name: Group
items.note: Rich Group(*renderables); hud Group::new().push(item): builder push.

items.name: Padding
items.note: Rich Padding(renderable, pad=(0,0,0,0), *, style, expand=True); hud Padding::new(renderable, pad) with .style() and .expand(): same operation, roles and order; byte-for-byte equal output in tests/padding.rs (D-046).

items.name: cell_len
items.note: Rich cell_len(text, unicode_version='auto') -> int; hud cell_len(&str) -> usize: same role and order; the Unicode version is fixed at build time.
